base_local_change_scope: Cross-language pipeline hardened to real-world measurement. incr.py: two new incrementalization pattern classes -- dict argmax (d[k]=d.get(k,0)+POS writes plus keys() rescan with tiebreak become update-site tracking) and sliding window sum (del xs[0] sites emit _wacc-=xs[0]); probe 64/64, mode/wma translations fire with byte-identical oracles. pkg-v12: str(<float>) enabled via existing ail_str_from_float FMT machinery (SEMANTICS.md updated). jstrans.py: deterministic JS->subset translator -- float profile (Number/parseFloat, JS Number->String formatting: integral doubles without .0, NaN/Infinity, -0->0, true / on floats, IEEE remainder), plus parser-surface hardening (ASI, shebang, new Array, function-expr arrows, stdin line-terminator fix via rstrip, null-sentinel re-kinding via vartypes/zero_of, trivial-function inlining, named TErrs for all remaining unsupported constructs). Corpus 17/17 byte-identical vs Node; real-world corpus 0->2 end-to-end with zero generic crashes (12 named TErrs). dominfer.py: machine-derived input domains via differential probing (found 2^53+ integer JS precision boundary on all add-protocol programs).
